title: Contracting points of a cocharacter
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $G$ be an $F$-group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme]. Let $\eta:\mathbf G_m\to G$ be a group homomorphism, using the standard affine-line and multiplicative group schemes [def-sc-gm-ga]. For every $F$-scheme $W$ and $g:W\to G$, say that $g$ contracts under $\eta$ if the morphism $\mathbf G_m\times_F W\to G$, $(t,w)\mapsto\eta(t)g(w)\eta(t)^{-1}$, extends to $\mathbf A^1\times_F W\to G$ whose restriction to $\{0\}\times_F W$ is the identity section. The punctured-line inclusion is induced by $F[x]\to F[t,t^{-1}]$, $x\mapsto t$.
